Your 60-Second Poster Workflow: From Idea to Launch
1. Brief Your Agent

Forget complex forms. Simply tell Lovart your goal in plain English in the ChatCanvas. Describe the event, the offer, and the vibe. Our MCoT engine understands your business intent, not just keywords.
2. Generate & Orchestrate
In seconds, Lovart generates multiple, unique poster concepts. It automatically creates variations for different channels—social media, print, and web—all while maintaining perfect brand consistency.
3. Refine & Deploy

Love a design but need a tweak? Use Touch Edit to change any element with a click. Preview your poster on a real-world billboard with Smart Mockups, then export in high-resolution print or digital formats.

Small Business Owner
Can the AI handle complex poster information like dates, locations, and multiple speakers?

Yes. Our MCoT engine is designed to understand and structure complex information. You can specify all your event details in the prompt, and Lovart will intelligently place them according to proper design hierarchy, ensuring clarity and readability.
How does Lovart ensure my posters don't look like generic templates?

Lovart generates every design from scratch based on your unique prompt and brand DNA. Unlike template-based tools, it learns your aesthetic from the ChatCanvas, ensuring your posters are original and aligned with your specific brand identity.
What if I need to change just one small thing on the generated poster?

That's what our exclusive Touch Edit and Text Edit features are for. You can click on any object or text to modify it directly without regenerating the entire image. This gives you the fine-grained control of traditional software with the speed of AI.
Can I get high-resolution files suitable for professional printing?
Absolutely. You can export your posters in high-resolution formats like PNG and SVG, with options for CMYK color profiles, making them perfectly suitable for professional digital and offset printing.
Do I have full commercial rights to use the posters I generate?
Yes. All users on our paid plans (Starter, Plus, Pro) have full commercial rights to use the posters for any business purpose, including advertising, marketing, and merchandise.
